name: THUG2 Vita
author: iwannagooutside
description:
Native PS Vita port of Tony Hawk's Underground 2 (2004). Not an emulator: the same engine as THUG Vita, rebuilt for the Vita with a vitaGL graphics backend and extended to run THUG2.
Story mode, Classic mode, Free Skate and every create mode, most views at or near 60 fps, with FMVs and the THUG Pro HD HUD. No game data included: you need your own copy of the game.
